tables.title: the rows this gate ran
rows: 1 THE SETS AND THE RULE'S CONSTANTS: Round 4's presets and caps; DECIDE_T 4 s, THRESHOLD 20; HELD 120 seeds; DEV and HELD new (not Rounds 3-4's, rock nav's, the doctrine round's or the gates')
2 THE SIGNAL: 20 or more damage chooses cap 20, less keeps 12

3 THE ARMS FLY: the cap holds in every arm; the signal decides once at 4 s by the damage it read; it chooses 20 against ace and 12 against regular on this seed; a SIGNAL fight that keeps 12 IS the FIXED12 fight

ace FIXED12 R 0 chose null at null (damage null); ace FIXED20 R 0 chose null at null (damage null); ace SIGNAL R 0 chose 20 at 120 (damage 140); regular FIXED12 R 1592 chose null at null (damage null); regular FIXED20 R 900 chose null at null (damage null); regular SIGNAL R 1592 chose 12 at 120 (damage 10)
4 THE BOTTOM LINE IS ROUND 4's WITH SIGNAL READ AS ADAPT: HAS BOTH / PAYS ON THE WEAK SIDE / MISSES THE STRONG SIDE / HAS NEITHER
THE SIGNAL CAP HAS BOTH / THE SIGNAL CAP PAYS ON THE WEAK SIDE (regular) / THE SIGNAL CAP MISSES THE STRONG SIDE (perfect) / THE SIGNAL CAP HAS NEITHER (green, ace, perfect)
5 THE SIGNAL'S CHOICES ARE COUNTED PER PRESET, AND ITS ACCURACY IS RIGHT WHEN 20 IS CHOSEN AGAINST THE STRONG AND 12 AGAINST THE WEAK

6 DEV'S CHECKS PASS ON GOOD ROWS AND EACH FAILS ON ITS OWN FAULT (a choice against the damage; a decision off 4 s; no 20 under a strong preset; thrust over the cap; a kept-12 fight unlike FIXED12's; a fight that does not end)
7 THE COMMAND: export-free; HELD refused before DEV passes; an unknown option refused; a part never flown twice
8 reportLines NAMES THE SIGNAL'S NUMBERS AND THE SETS
